Class UDFDataFill

java.lang.Object
grafioschtrader.entities.UDFDataFill
@Entity public class UDFDataFill extends Object
Fill state of one cell: the user-defined security field idUDFMetadata for the security idEntity. The provenance cannot live in udf_data.json_values itself, because UDFData.checkDataAgainstMetadata removes every key that is not the key of a field, so a marker key would be dropped at the next save of the user. A value is automatic only while the cell holds exactly filledValue; once the user changed it, the next fill run treats it as manual and deletes the row. The table has no id_user: the owner is the owner of the field, whose udf_data row holds the value. Rows are written exclusively by UDFFillWriter.
